item.title: Explosions, gunfire rock Niger capital near international airport
item.description: Nighttime blasts and tracer fire light up skies over Niamey as authorities offer no immediate explanation and pro-junta voices urge citizens to mobilise.

item.title: US judge blocks Trump policy targeting lawful refugees in Minnesota
item.description: A federal judge in Minnesota temporarily blocked a Trump administration policy allowing the arrest of lawful refugees awaiting green cards.

item.title: Melania Trump's documentary premieres at the Kennedy Center ahead of global release
item.description: “Melania” will premiere on Thursday at the Kennedy Center, where the Trumps are expected to walk the red carpet before the film opens in theatres worldwide on Friday.

item.title: Three arrested over deadly attack at amateur football game in Mexico’s Guanajuato
item.description: Guanajuato is the country's deadliest state due to gang turf wars, according to official homicide statistics.

item.title: ASEAN urged to uphold rule of law as ‘unilateral actions’ threaten regional order
item.description: Philippine Foreign Secretary Theresa Lazaro warns that rising geopolitical tensions risk undermining international law, urging ASEAN to stay united, restrained and committed to a rules-based order.

item.title: China executes 11 Myanmar telecom scam gang members
item.description: Eleven convicts linked to Myanmar fraud operations were executed after China’s top court approved death sentences over violent and financial crimes.

item.title: Daily News Brief | 29 January
item.description: OIC calls on UN Security Council to take urgent action on Palestine. And, Federal Reserve resists White House demands to slash interest rates.

item.title: Dollar wobbles as investors see increasing risks
item.description: The dollar remains weak after this week’s selloff, with investors focused on the Fed outlook and uncertainty surrounding US economic policy.

item.title: Colombian president urges Latin American countries to unite in wake of US attack on Venezuela
item.description: 'We do not want Caracas or any country in the Americas to be targeted with missiles, neither from the north nor from the south,' Gustavo Petro says.

item.title: Cairo ready to receive wounded from Gaza, deliver aid once Rafah crossing reopens: Egypt
item.description: 'Crisis management centre is working on possible scenarios, including the delivery of aid,' says North Sinai governor.
